summary.text: Yvonne Davis is a Democratic state representative from Texas who has represented District 111 since 1993 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Yvonne Davis assumed office in the Texas House on January 12, 1993.
In 2023 and 2024 she was assigned to the House Transportation Committee and the Judiciary & Civil Jurisprudence Committee.
